field_sampling: Controlled relative contexts with independent generator groups; translation/reflection descendants retain their ancestor. External game panels use the existing disjoint adaptation/calibration/test partitions. No field-model predictions enter sampling.
field_transfer: Sliding-piece training distances 1,2,4; dedicated long-range holdout distances 3,5,6,7. Shape and occupancy pooling are supplied representational assumptions, not learned abstraction.
field_dependence: At most one observation per connected dependence/ancestry group and relative conditional. Contradictions within a group are withheld; independent contradictions revise both native channels.
legal_completion: Isolated exact local-condition revision on new special-move curriculum, with supplied history. Preserve the entire frozen inference source and default checkpoint. Previous-cycle failures are development diagnostics, not an untouched test population.
native_composition: Existing unary conditional rules only. No new operator or joint positive safety proof.
git_policy: Local commits only; no push, deployment, or upstream modification.
